Agent Name: Planner
 Step Number: 13
 Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted IMDb’s metadata, incorrectly combining the month/day (Feb 28) with the “1991” in the film’s title as the release year, yielding a false date of 1991-02-28. This led to the wrong conclusion that Dilan 1991 came out before Celine (2010). The correct IMDb/Wikipedia information indicates Dilan 1991 was released in 2019-02-28, but the Planner failed to properly verify and compare the dates.
